title: verify.rs: per-cert DER re-encoding in find_cert linear scan
description: smime-tree/src/verify.rs: find_cert() pre-computes sid_issuer_der once, but then calls to_der().map(|a| a == sid_issuer_der) inside the linear scan over all certs in the SignedData certificate bag. Each iteration DER-encodes the cert's issuer fresh, allocating a Vec<u8> per cert. For a message with a large cert bag (common in S/MIME, where all intermediate certs are included), this is O(certs * issuer_der_size) work and allocation per SignerInfo. Pre-computing a HashMap<Vec<u8>, &Certificate> keyed by issuer DER (the same pattern used in cert.rs build_chain) would reduce this to O(1) lookup.
close_reason: P2 efficiency: per-cert DER re-encoding in find_cert is O(n) with small n (typical cert bag is 1-3 certs, now capped at 100). The SID issuer DER is pre-computed once outside the loop.
